Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API cost guardrails + peak TPS confirmation

Hi Emily —

Great to chat earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get a crisp pricing note over to procurement: 

What I heard on the call:
- Production read: ~8–12M tokens/month initially, with a product-led spike possibility to ~35M in promotional months.
- Typical request size: 300–600 tokens; a small subset of requests (search/recall flows) hit ~1.5k tokens.
- Concurrency/peak: baseline ~60 TPS, expected peak bursts up to ~220 TPS for 4–6 minute windows during morning syncs.
- Cost target: you mentioned a target of ~ $12–15 / 1M tokens (benchmark for initial renewal discussions).

Actions I need from you to make the pricing concrete:
1) Confirm whether the 35M spike is a planned marketing push (scheduled) or an opportunistic burst we should size for.
2) If you have a short sample of production traffic shape (timestamps + token counts) that would be perfect — I attached a blank CSV template if helpful.
3) Are there any security/compliance must-haves (e.g., VPC peering, HITRUST evidence) we should include in the options sheet?

Next steps on our side: I’ll have a short two-option price note (pay-as-you-go hosted + a 12-month commit band) and an ops note about how we handle burst capacity and graceful degradation under sustained spikes.

Attaching a lightweight pricing options PDF and a sample traffic template. I’ll loop Karthik on the detailed unit-econ ask.

Thanks — enjoyed the product walkthrough.

—So
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: argentum-prod-traffic-sample.csv (CSV template), RWF-hosted-pricing-options.pdf (pricing summary)

Subject: Re: Hosted API cost guardrails + peak TPS confirmation

Thanks, Soojin — appreciated the recap. Quick answers below.

1) The 35M spike is a planned marketing push for late Nov (targeted outreach). It's scheduled, we can provide the campaign window and expected daily ramp.
2) I attached a small anonymized extract of our last 30 days (timestamps + token counts). We redacted PHI but you should see the burst patterns.
3) Compliance: HITRUST is not required, but we do need SOC2 Type II and a contractual right to audit logs for a subset of calls for 90 days. VPC peering is preferred but not mandatory for initial pilot.

Two clarifications from our side: 
- When you say "peak bursts up to 220 TPS," is that sustained throughput or short-lived concurrency bursts? We want to understand how Redwood bills for burst capacity vs. reserved capacity.
- Our procurement lead wants an illustrative $/1M token price for both PAYG and a 12-month committed slab so we can run numbers for the SOW.

I'll give the sample traffic a quick scrub and send it in the next email.

—Emily
Emily Clark
Head of Product, Argentum Health
emily.clark@argentumhealth.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurements@argentumhealth.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API cost guardrails + peak TPS confirmation

Emily — thanks for the quick turnaround and the extract. Got the compliance notes; SOC2 Type II and 90-day audit logs are standard for our Dedicated and Private options, and available as an add-on for Hosted (we'll call that out).

To clarify billing semantics: 
- Pay-as-you-go (hosted): billed per-token (monthly invoice) with automatic elastic serving. Short-lived bursts are served by our elastic pool; you only pay for the tokens consumed. There is no separate "burst" line item.
- Committed slab (12-month): you agree on a monthly token band (e.g., 8M base + 27M burst buffer across the year) at a discounted $/1M rate; we model expected overage and tiered true-up. For scheduled marketing pushes we offer temporary burst credits and pre-scheduled scaling at lower marginal price if included in the commit.

I asked Karthik to scope two illustrative numbers (PAYG and 12-month commit) using your baseline 8–12M and the 35M promo spike. He'll include an estimated $/1M target vs. a conservative scenario.

Forwarding the anonymized extract to Karthik and Marissa now.

—So

On Wed, Oct 21, 2026 at 08:56 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks — I took a quick pass on the sample. High-level takeaways:
> - Median request ~420 tokens, 95th pct ~1.1k; traffic is spiky with daily morning peaks (matches your note).
> - The promo window looks like 10 business days with a 3–4x uplift in daily tokens, concentrated in 2–3 hour windows.
>
> Pricing illustrations (ballpark, list):
> 1) PAYG hosted: $17 / 1M tokens (no minimum), elastic serving; monthly invoice.
> 2) 12-month commit, conservative band (8M base/month): $13 / 1M tokens up to the committed band, overage tier at $16 / 1M.
> 3) 12-month commit, aggressive band (12M base/month with scheduled promo buffer): $11 / 1M tokens inside band, $14 / 1M overage.
>
> Notes on peak TPS and ops: for advertised bursts to ~220 TPS we recommend a light pre-scaling window (30–60 minutes before campaign start) to warm KV caches. If you prefer zero-ops on your side, we can include pre-scheduled scale as an add-on at an estimated incremental cost (we'll itemize).
>
> Next asks for procurement:
> - Which slab would you like an SOW for (conservative vs. aggressive)?
> - Is single-tenant Dedicated required or is hosted OK for the pilot? Dedicated changes SLAs/pricing.
>
> I'll drop a short two-slide summary for procurement and a synthetic bill-of-units that maps to the sample extract.
>
> —Karthik

Subject: Hosted pricing + ops note for Argentum — illustrative numbers

Emily / Procurement team —

I pulled together the illustrative pricing and a short ops checklist (attached as PDF). TL;DR: pick one of the commit bands below and we'll convert to a draft SOW and pricing appendix.

Illustrative options (per month):
A) PAYG Hosted
- No minimum. Elastic serving. List price estimate: $17 / 1M tokens.
- Good if you want no upfront commitment and to test world-scale load patterns.

B) 12-month conservative commit
- Band: 8M tokens / month. Price: $13 / 1M tokens within band. Overage: $16 / 1M.
- Includes 2 scheduled burst windows per quarter (up to 1.5x baseline for 8 hours) at no extra marginal charge.

C) 12-month aggressive commit (recommended if you want smoother unit economics for marketing push)
- Band: 12M tokens / month. Price: $11 / 1M tokens within band. Overage: $14 / 1M.
- Includes one pre-scheduled campaign warm-up (up to 48 hours of elevated buffer) and priority capacity during the campaign window.

Operational notes: 
- For short 3–6 minute micro-bursts to 220 TPS we serve elastically; no special billing. For scheduled campaigns we recommend pre-warming (30–60m) to reduce p95 latency and token cost risk.
- SOC2 Type II + 90-day audit log export is included in all options as an add-on; VPC peering is included for Dedicated and available for hosted as a billable setup.

Requested confirmation from procurement: which of A/B/C should I draft an SOW for (we will include the pricing appendix and the campaign warm-up scheduling clause)? Also confirm any additional required compliance artifacts.

I attached: RWF-hosted-pricing-options.pdf (pricing table + ops checklist) and a synthetic bill-of-units CSV mapped to your sample.

—Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
